limits: Focused checks cover the changed Zig/WebGPU upload and renderer paths; the full package test suite was not rerun.
Hardware timing is ASCII-only under the reviewed benchmark qualification.
Latency is compositor acknowledgement of the submitting terminal frame in headless-shell, not optical or physical-vsync latency.
GPU-process CPU is host CPU consumption, not GPU-device execution time.
Prototype-counter and Dawn traces are perturbed attribution evidence, separate from ordinary output CPU timing.
The sparse upload-only decision probe waits for queue completion after each batch and has no terminal rendering, presentation or CPU pass verdict.
No production deployment or merge is part of this unmerged PR task.
Fresh GPU seam values are shared-process window averages normalized by actual terminal renders, not isolated per-canvas costs.
Fresh trace compares WebGPU/Zig with native WebGL/JS and xterm WebGL implementations; graphics API and frame builder are not isolated.
Native WebGL direct upload byte coverage is unqualified; zero direct-counter bytes do not indicate zero uploads.
No shared WebGPU canvas treatment or production Linux renderer-default change was run.
